title: Van Allen radiation belt impassable
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Van Allen radiation belt impassable, about 1960s at Van Allen belts, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Danny brings this up on his podcast where James Van Allen who you know it's named after is saying that is 150 times what a normal human can take radiation wise

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels repeats a point he says another host, Danny Jones, raised on his own show. The point is about the Van Allen belts, zones of radiation that surround the Earth, and their namesake, the 1960s scientist James Van Allen. Michels says Van Allen stated the radiation there was about 150 times what a normal person can take, which would raise questions about how people could travel through it into space.
